summary: Backend + Frontend validation of the notification reply-thread feature. Backend pytest suite (backend/tests/) — 53/53 passed (including the new TestNotificationThread class: 2/2). Frontend Playwright e2e: seeded a fresh TEST_ notification via API, opened it in OrgDashboard bell → dialog rendered with Admin-message label, title, Received timestamp, whitespace-preserved body, Conversation section, notif-reply-input textarea + notif-reply-send button (disabled-when-empty, enabled-after-typing). Typed a multi-line reply and clicked Send — captured POST /api/contact-admin body confirmed in_reply_to = notification.id, 'Reply sent to admin' toast fired, textarea cleared, and the reply appeared optimistically in the Conversation section. Ctrl+Enter shortcut also triggered send. Closed + reopened the dialog: both replies were re-fetched from GET /api/notifications/{nid}/thread and rendered (4 replies persisted; previous iteration threads still present). On the Super Admin panel /admin the AdminInbox displayed a 'REPLY' badge on both threaded messages and body preserved newlines (whitespace-pre-wrap). Copy + Close + X + Escape from iteration_8 still work.
action_items: Cleanup TEST_ prefixed AdminMessages/Notifications: no HTTP delete endpoint exposed for /api/admin/messages or /api/admin/notifications. Consider adding DELETE endpoints (admin-only) OR running a mongo cleanup like `db.admin_messages.delete_many({'subject': {'$regex': '^Re: TEST_'}})` + `db.notifications.delete_many({'title': {'$regex': '^TEST_'}})`. Current test run seeded 1 notification (title TEST_reply_persist) and 2 reply messages (subject Re: TEST_reply_persist). Iteration_8 also left TEST_ notifications behind.
critical_code_review_comments: OrgDashboard.jsx is now 782 lines — has crossed the 700-line soft limit. Recommend extracting the NotificationBell + NotificationDialog + ContactAdminDialog + UploadDocsCard + SharePackCard components into /components/notifications/*.jsx and /components/dashboard/*.jsx.

NotificationDialog: the useEffect that fetches the thread depends on `notif` (the whole object). If a parent re-renders and passes a new object reference for the same id, the effect will refetch. Consider `useEffect(..., [notif?.id])` to make refetch strictly id-based.

Optimistic append pushes the API response into `replies` locally after send. If the user sends 2 replies quickly and the backend orders by created_at (oldest first), the local append order matches server order — good. But if send fails after optimistic add, currently the local state does NOT rollback (append happens inside try before await? — actually after await, so this is fine). No action needed.

Backend GET /api/notifications/{nid}/thread returns 404 when the notification is missing — verified. But the same endpoint does not verify the requesting org actually owns the notification (no auth in this app yet, so acceptable, but worth noting when auth is added).
No DELETE endpoint for admin messages/notifications makes test data cleanup painful. Consider `DELETE /api/admin/messages/{id}` and `DELETE /api/admin/notifications/{id}` (admin-only).
Reply badge on /admin uses text 'Reply' (not 'REPLY') — the requirement said REPLY badge. The badge has `uppercase` Tailwind class so it renders as 'REPLY' visually. Verified in screenshot. Good.
test_credentials: No auth. Role switcher: [data-testid=role-switcher] → [data-testid=role-org] / [data-testid=role-admin]. Org slug: blackrod-town-council. OrgDashboard path: /organisation-dashboard.
seed_data_creation: Seeded 1 notification (title=TEST_reply_persist, id=1bf90f8a-8d29-4c66-9f20-4bc48c17246d) and 2 AdminMessages with in_reply_to pointing to it (subjects Re: TEST_reply_persist, bodies TEST_reply_line1_1bf90f + TEST_ctrl_enter_1bf90f). All remain in Mongo — see action_items for cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reply-thread flow is fully verified end-to-end. Testids in play: notification-bell, notification-count, notif-<id>, notification-dialog, notif-reply-input, notif-reply-send, notif-reply-<id> (per reply), notif-dialog-copy, notif-dialog-close. Backend endpoints: POST /api/contact-admin accepts optional in_reply_to; GET /api/notifications/{nid}/thread returns {notification, replies[]}; 404 if notif missing. OrgDashboard route is /organisation-dashboard (not /org-dashboard). Clipboard permissions must be granted for the Copy button (page.context.grant_permissions(['clipboard-read','clipboard-write'])).
